project.name: rapid
project.description: Utility applications for iOS, iPadOS and macOS users for specialized or niche capabilities.

business_context.problem: Solves various utility problems. Completely local, using local foundational models and local on-device capabilities.
business_context.value: These are utilities. Anyone with the specialized need these applications solve will find them useful.
business_context.scope: Applications for cropping images in predefined ways, providing emotional intelligence and quotient feedback in meetings and more.
business_context.constraints: Should always use local foundational models for AI. Should always use on-device capabilities and APIs without requiring any proprietary external system. Open source or creative commons resources downloaded locally are allowed. Privacy and security are key.
